name: product-shot
title: Product Shot
description: One shot of a real product screen. The camera frames one named region of the screenshot and moves to another: wide to close, a pan, or a hold. On top of the screenshot it can move a cursor to a component and click it, type text into an input, and outline a component. A short label can sit in the frame. Cut several of these together to show a product working; one shot shows one thing.

variables.label: Screen
variables.description: Supplied by the compiler from the scene's screen.

variables.label: Screen geometry
variables.description: Supplied by the compiler: the screen's size and regions as JSON.

variables.label: Isolated component
variables.description: Show only this component of the screen, floating on the stage, instead of the whole window. The camera, cursor and outline still use region names.

variables.label: Corner radius
variables.description: Corner radius of what is shown, in the screenshot's pixels. Match the isolated component's own corners.

variables.label: Start framing
variables.description: The region the camera frames at the start. window is the whole screen.

variables.label: End framing
variables.description: The region the camera frames at the end. Empty holds on the start framing with a slow drift.

variables.label: Frame fill
variables.description: How much of the frame the framed region may take, by width or height. Lower leaves more space around it.

variables.label: Perspective
variables.description: Turn the screen in perspective. A 2.5D transform of the flat screenshot.

variables.label: Entrance
variables.description: none for a cut. rise brings the screen up into the frame, for the first time the product is seen.

variables.label: Cursor target
variables.description: The component the cursor travels to. Empty for no cursor.

variables.label: Click
variables.description: Click when the cursor arrives.

variables.label: Click moment
variables.description: When the cursor arrives, as a fraction of the shot.

variables.label: Outlined component
variables.description: A component to outline in the accent colour. Empty for none.

variables.label: Typed-into component
variables.description: The input the text is typed into. Use the text area itself, not the whole control.

variables.label: Typed text
variables.description: What gets typed. It should be what the next screen shows as entered.

variables.label: Typed text colour
variables.description: Match the input's text colour in the screenshot.

variables.label: Input background
variables.description: Match the input's background in the screenshot; it covers the placeholder.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: A few words naming what the shot shows. Empty for none.

variables.label: Emphasised word
variables.description: A word of the label to set in the accent colour.

variables.label: Accent colour
variables.description: The film's one accent. Used for emphasis only.
